worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.summary: Erupt a ring of caustic gas around yourself: the held items of every other body inside are melted away for good and nobody gets them; bodies without an item are left briefly tainted. It deals no damage and treats allies the same.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.0: Melt the held items of everything closing in at once
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.1: Clear the field in an item war so both sides lose their held item
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.2: Ruin Berries, Gems and Leftovers together
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.descripti: Spread caustic gas about %1$s blocks around yourself; every non-self body inside carries the corroded identity for %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.spread.on: Spread on: cloud radius x1.3 and cooldown +8 ticks, covering a wider circle.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.spread.of: Spread off: cloud radius x0.85 and cooldown -6 ticks, smaller but more frequent.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.timing: Cast around yourself; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.growth.0: At level %1$s the cloud radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.growth.1: At level %1$s the cloud radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.preferenc: On: radius x1.3 and cooldown +8 ticks, covering a wider circle. Off: radius x0.85 and cooldown -6 ticks, smaller but more frequent. Area trades against cast frequency.
The companion considers the cloud only when the threat is within this distance; smaller means only at close range, larger means covering a distant crowd earlier.
Only when a holder is inside
On: only used when at least one body inside the cloud carries an item, as a dedicated melt tool. Off: it fires as long as an enemy is inside, tainting them too.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to spray. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.corrosivegas.text.fizz: The acid licks by, nothing to melt
world_combat.move.corrosivegas.text.tain: The gas spreads; mist lingers %1$s s
